tasks.label: Replay: all samples
tasks.command: gcc -I. -I.. -o run_replay test_replay.c ../main/message_decoder.c log_capture.c && ./run_replay; ec=$?; rm -f ./run_replay; exit $ec

tasks.label: Replay: bless all samples
tasks.command: gcc -I. -I.. -o run_replay test_replay.c ../main/message_decoder.c log_capture.c && ./run_replay --bless; ec=$?; rm -f ./run_replay; exit $ec

tasks.label: Replay: single file
tasks.command: gcc -I. -I.. -o run_replay test_replay.c ../main/message_decoder.c log_capture.c && ./run_replay ${input:samplePath}; ec=$?; rm -f ./run_replay; exit $ec

tasks.label: Replay: bless single file
tasks.command: gcc -I. -I.. -o run_replay test_replay.c ../main/message_decoder.c log_capture.c && ./run_replay --bless ${input:samplePath}; ec=$?; rm -f ./run_replay; exit $ec

tasks.label: Framing: run
tasks.command: gcc -I. -I.. -o run_framing test_framing.c log_capture.c && ./run_framing; ec=$?; rm -f ./run_framing; exit $ec

tasks.label: Framing: bless goldens
tasks.command: gcc -I. -I.. -o run_framing test_framing.c log_capture.c && ./run_framing --bless; ec=$?; rm -f ./run_framing; exit $ec

inputs.description: Sample path (relative to test/, e.g. samples/temperature.txt)
